name: web-dementia-care-app-site-in-indigo-and-gold
title: Care-app landing page with indigo-to-white fade, gold cards and a large warm portrait
whatItIs: A tall board with a long page and a second column. The hero has an indigo night gradient with a smiling older woman, italic serif 'Care, from anywhere.', store badges and a laurel. Below are a phone with orbit icons, tilted gold and indigo stat cards (94%, 82%, +90%), numbered step cards, tinted testimonial photos and a knowledge carousel.
whatItMeans: Warm, dignified and reassuring; gold on indigo feels caring rather than clinical.
techniques: Fade an indigo hero into white.
Tint testimonial photos in the two brand colours.
Tilt stat cards in gold and indigo.

vocabulary.definition: A quote photo coloured in brand hues.
A rotated card with a big percentage.
A dark hero blending to white.
